string.name: call_voicemail

string.comment: Button that opens settings to grant the permission required by the current screen.

string.comment: Button that retries loading or activating visual voicemail.

string.name: visual_voicemail_unavailable
string.comment: Title shown when visual voicemail cannot be activated.

string.name: visual_voicemail_unavailable_description
string.comment: Explanation shown when the carrier or device does not support visual voicemail.

string.comment: Empty-state title shown when visual voicemail contains no messages.

string.name: visual_voicemail_no_messages_description
string.comment: Empty-state explanation shown when visual voicemail is active but contains no messages.
